svg.title: BlaBla agent workflow
svg.desc: An agent starts from the AGENTS.md block and runs blabla status, then blabla explain to recover only the relevant memory and rules. Where a project uses the development loop, the orchestrator opens a bounded task recording write scope and deliverables; a worker implements inside that scope and runs the focused checks that cover the change. blabla challenge then checks the recorded account against deterministic evidence, which is separate from the independent reviewer role that reads the diff and records findings. The orchestrator resolves findings and integrates. Only blabla finish decides project completion, and a challenge does not change its verdict or its exit code.
